Lyons Wealth Management Has Increased Position in Apple (AAPL) as Shares Declined; Troy Asset Management LTD Has Cut Its Microsoft (MSFT) Position by $7.61 Million as Market Valuation Rose
April 30, 2018 - By Peter Erickson
Troy Asset Management Ltd decreased its stake in Microsoft Corp (MSFT) by 2.59% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Troy Asset Management Ltd sold 89,500 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.63% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 3.36M shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $287.65M, down from 3.45M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Troy Asset Management Ltd who had been investing in Microsoft Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $721.61 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.98% or $1.9 $93.92. About 24.11M shares traded. Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) has risen 37.43% uptrending. It has outperformed by 25.88% the S&P500.
Lyons Wealth Management Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 326.71% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC.
